masterPrompts.male:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Edit target Image1: a FOUR-column ONE-row pixel RPG sprite sheet. REMOVE the ENTIRE head from EACH of the four character poses. Output the SAME FOUR POSES as genuinely HEADLESS BODY sprite assets.
DELETE completely: face, skull, all hair (including tiny side strands and nape), ears, eyes, all bare-skin neck. The region formerly occupied by the whole head must become TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. No silhouette, dark placeholder, mannequin head, flesh fragments, wig, hair behind gloves, head hiding under hands, scarf, hood or cowl.
PRESERVE EXACTLY: every body/outfit pixel, all hands and fingers, full forearms and elbows/ivory sleeves, shoulders, collar seam, iron chest armor, green short cloak, belt, trousers, boots and the one steel sword. Hands and sword must remain intact even ABOVE or IN FRONT OF the old head. In the overhead pose this means two raised arms forming an OPEN EMPTY SPACE between them, with both hands gripping the sword above that transparent space. Remove head pixels BEHIND the hands without cutting out any part of gloves or fingers. Never erase arms merely because they intersect the head area. In the standing/walking pose preserve natural wide shoulders and a very short closed cloth neckline, no long thin neck tube. Collar belongs to outfit; no skin.
Keep the exact original body dimensions, camera, proportions, pixel grid, fine clean pixel detail, color palette and source column positions. NO scale/zoom/repose, no new effects, no labels, no shadows, no blur. Canvas1774×887 same four columns, baselineY805. This is an extraction of the existing body, not a new character illustration. After you finish it must be impossible to recognize ANY remnant of the original hair/face/ears in the body sprites. Empty avatar socket ready for a separate head. All transparency must be real alpha, no checkerboard painted in.
